Acme Widgets — Bug Bounty Program (HackerOne)

In scope:
  - Source repository: https://github.com/acme/widgets (source_repo)
  - Production web app: https://app.acme.test (web)

Out of scope:
  - Anything under /legacy/ (deprecated, scheduled for removal)
  - third_party/ vendored dependencies

Rules of engagement:
  - This is an authorized test with safe harbor.
  - Automated tooling against the source repository is permitted.
  - Hard limits: no DoS / stress / volumetric testing; no automated scanning of live hosts;
    no social engineering.

Severity guidance: We pay highest for authn/authz bypass, SQLi, and SSRF reaching internal
services. Self-XSS and missing security headers are known/low.
